In order to keep this under control, new nuclear power plants are needed. However, the expansion of nuclear power faces enormous hurdles.

en: The heat attention: If it's mild, there is no longer any climate change. Because Europe is cooling down, the heat wave is forgotten. But discourse about the climate crisis must always take place - also so that its causes can be combated.
la: Calor attendit: Si mitis est, nulla coeli mutatione amplius. Quia Europa refrigerat, aestus unda oblita est. Discursus autem de discrimine climatis semper locum habet — etiam ut causae eius pugnari possint.

la: Mutatio climatis: Plus quam 500 caloris mortes in Bavaria. Secundum aestimationem Roberti Koch Instituti, figura totius anni superioris iam excessit. Bavaria nihilominus minus afficitur quam aliae civitates foederatae.

de: Globale Erwärmung: RKI geht von Tausenden Toten durch Juni-Hitzewelle aus. Noch sorgt Kälte in Europa für mehr Sterbefälle als Hitze. Doch das ändert sich mit dem Klimawandel. Aktuelle Berechnungen gehen für Juni von 4300 Hitzetoten in Deutschland aus.
en: Global warming: RKI assumes thousands of deaths due to June heat wave. Cold weather still causes more deaths in Europe than heat. But that is changing with climate change. Current calculations assume 4,300 heat deaths in Germany in June.
la: Calefactionem Global: RKI mille mortes assumit ob undam caloris Iunii. Tempestas frigoris adhuc plures mortes in Europa efficit quam caloris. Sed id mutatur cum mutatione climatis. Calculi currentis mortes in Germania mense Iunio 4,300 caloris mortes assumunt.
